name: Watershed Security Fund Grants Program (B.C.)
summary: British Columbia grants in three streams (up to $50,000, $150,000 or $400,000) for community-led watershed work, including ecosystem restoration, monitoring and nature-based infrastructure, in numbered application intakes.

amount.note: Three streams with maximums of $50,000, $150,000 and $400,000

status.quote: The fourth round of grant applications is open from October 5 to November 10, 2026.

opens.quote: The fourth round of grant applications is open from October 5 to November 10, 2026.

deadline.quote: Please coordinate the time with our team well in advance so that we can schedule the call, review, and finalize the application content before the November 10, 2026 deadline.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible organizations for WSF grant funding include First Nations and non-First Nations organizations in any of these categories: Registered Non-profit Educational Institution Social Enterprise (C3) And: First Nation (including First Nation governments, Tribal Councils and others) Local/Regional Government

geography.quote: supporting watershed work and partnerships in all regions of British Columbia

access.quote: The online portal enables our Grants Program team to process applications more efficiently.

window.quote: The fourth round of grant applications is open from October 5 to November 10, 2026.
